subject: Energy
title: Levelized Cost of Energy
description: Learn Levelized Cost of Energy in one minute.

hook.text: LCOE calculates the total lifetime cost of a power plant divided by its total energy output—a fair comparison metric.

buildup.text: It includes construction, fuel, maintenance, and financing—everything needed to produce one MWh over a plant's life.

discovery.text: Solar LCOE fell from $359/MWh in 2009 to about $30/MWh today—the steepest cost decline in energy history.

twist.text: LCOE doesn't capture intermittency costs—solar is cheap per MWh but needs storage to deliver power around the clock.

climax.text: Even including storage, solar-plus-battery is now competitive with new gas plants in many world regions.

punchline.text: Cost per megawatt-hour—the number that decides which technology wins.
